messages:
Ava (CEO): Quick weekly — two-minute exec update with asks and priorities for next week. TL;DR: stabilize Dedicated throughput, push Private pilot onboarding, and ship Optimize v0.9. Please read and react. Exec sync Tue 10:00am PT.

Miguel (VP Product): Product priorities: canary for Optimize v0.9 scheduled Wed AM. Metrics to watch: hosted gen p95 = 240ms (current) -> goal 200ms; weighted cost/unit ~ $0.0032/token -> target $0.0026. Need a short plan for model compaction & quant profiles.

Riley (VP Eng): Infra plan: autoscaler tuning + smarter bin-packing tonight. Deploy window Tue 02:00-04:00 PST. Canary traffic will start at 5% and ramp. Fallback route -> fallback to quantized-8bit model if errors spike. @Miguel can you confirm canary prompt set? :+1:

Miguel (VP Product): Sending canary prompt set to #eng-ml now — ~120 prompts covering latency and quality buckets.

Sam (Head of Ops): Incident recap (Fri): cache-eviction race caused ~20% error spike for ~22m (11:12-11:34 PST). Root cause: concurrent GC + eviction race in KVCacher. Hotfix deployed (hotfix id 1843123600) and monitoring stabilized. Postmortem Wed 15:00 PT. Runbook updates + alert threshold tweak are action items.

Sam (Head of Ops): Relevant log snippet from root cause:
```
[2028-07-12T11:12:03Z] KVCacher::evict(): race detected, evicting same key twice
[2028-07-12T11:12:03Z] KVCacher::gc(): started concurrent sweep
[2028-07-12T11:12:04Z] ERR request_id=7f4a2 tokenize_error: cache-miss-fallback-rate=0.21
```

DeployBot: deploy optimize-service:v0.9 -> canary started. Sentry job 1843123680 succeeded :rocket:

Jordan (CFO): Finance notes: 3 new Dedicated contracts closed last week (~$2.1M ARR). Runway stable. Request: prioritize cost-by-route dashboards so we can surface unit economics to sales.

Ava (CEO): Two asks: 1) @Riley @Miguel — post canary success criteria by EOD Mon (latency, quality, error rate thresholds). 2) @Sam @Jordan — prepare customer-communication template for Private pilot covering security, billing, and next steps.

Riley (VP Eng): Will post canary criteria today. Revert criteria: error rate > 0.5% or p95 regression > 10% vs baseline.

Miguel (VP Product): Heads up: onboarding for open-llama-14b-qa delayed by ~1 week due to tokenizer mismatch in tokenization pipeline. Will update model onboarding board.

Ava (CEO): Thanks all. Short exec sync Tue 10:00am (calendar invite sent) — we'll review canary results, postmortem, and top sales asks. Ping me if you hit blockers. :eyes:
